label: TEST ONLY. Cycles MEASURED in simulation of hw/scp4d/rtl/scp4d_tdec_s.v (+ the unchanged v0.1.17 scp4d_fe_r.v), with the unchanged v0.1.13 scp4d_tdec_w and v0.1.17 scp4d_tdec_r decoding the same streams (outputs compared per frame and element), and of the closed loop with the unchanged v0.1.16 scp4d_tenc_q (same W); synthesis figures are ESTIMATES; no energy measured; all inputs are labelled synthetic or hand-written fixtures.

design.change: v0.1.17 scp4d_tdec_r's single issue chain split into two stages: a token classifier (fixed per-position roles, at most two narrow gap adds per cycle at K = 4, pop count by priority encode, element records with limit / frame end / error) and a bank issuer (last hold: event records in order until a bank repeats; zero / linear hold: aligned block of P elements around a cursor), joined by a record register and a pop-late record queue (RQ = 3W). Errors travel as records. Front end (scp4d_fe_r) and bank pipeline unchanged.
design.cycle_behaviour: changed; exact cycle model scripts/scp-v0118-rtl-model.ts (classifier runs during the state clear, head token classified alone, one record-register cycle, RQ = 3W occupancy rule, issuer window of P records with bank / block rules, tail 4)

Not a programmed-FPGA or silicon measurement; no board was used. xc7: yosys cell counts only (no open-source timing).
synthesis.wrapper: hw/scp4d/synth/scp4d_tdec_s_wrap.v: wrap_tdec_s = wrap_tdec_w (hw/scp4d/synth/scp4d_pnr_wrap.v) with the decoder swapped; wrap_loop_s = wrap_loop_q (hw/scp4d/synth/scp4d_tenc_q_wrap.v) with the decoder swapped (as wrap_tdec_r / wrap_loop_r in hw/scp4d/synth/scp4d_tdec_r_wrap.v). Stream inputs on pins, outputs registered and XOR-folded to 16 pins. The same wrapper logic is added to the new and the reference configurations.
